Now let me look at the uswid struct definition and the fuzzer build config:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜=command>find /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/fwupd -name "fu-uswid-struct*" -o -name "fu-coswid-struct*" | head -10 && echo "---" && grep -rn "uswid_fuzzer" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/fwupd/ --include="*.build" --include="*.py" --include="*.c" --include="*.h" --include="*.in" 2>/dev/null | head -20</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
